mapper.insert: insert into competition_participation (participation_id, ppt_path, pdf_path, submit_time, final_score, participation_status) values (#{participationId}, #{pptPath}, #{pdfPath}, #{submitTime}, #{finalScore}, #{participationStatus})
mapper.update: update competition_participation set ppt_path = #{pptPath}, pdf_path = #{pdfPath}, submit_time = #{submitTime}, final_score = #{finalScore}, participation_status = #{participationStatus} where participation_id = #{participationId}
mapper.select: select participation_id, ppt_path, pdf_path, submit_time, final_score, participation_status from competition_participation where participation_id = #{participationId}
